rules: C erases a block of 1s leftwards and stops on the 0 before it.
D fills a run of 0s rightwards with 1s.
B crosses pairs `1 1` rightwards, rewriting each as `1 0`.
C on a separator 0 walks left through a block of 1s, moving the block one cell right.
halts: The all-ones left counter of 4 bits with the right block at the top bit: `1^10 0 1^10 E>0`.
The all-ones left counter of 5 bits with the right block at the top bit: `1^12 0 1^13 E>0`.
The all-ones left counter of 6 bits with the right block at the top bit: `1^14 0 1^16 E>0`.
